cells.gaps: No source reports adoption of the Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030: it was validated in consultation on 12-13 October 2025 (SOM-004, SOM-006) and then said to be 'launched' by the government on 16 October 2025 (SOM-002) with no adopting act or body named. The Council of Ministers approved a separate Inclusive Digital Policy on 23 January 2025 (SOM-010), but no period or text is given for it and it is not the strategy, so it sets nothing here. No text has been found or linked, so no public-text row exists. No governance, delivery plan, reporting or last-twelve-months fact has been found.
cells.note: Instrument: Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030. Launched and validated but not adopted, so stage 2; stage 3 needs adoption and a public text.
